investmentJournal.name: Account name

investmentJournal.amountHelp: All amounts use the selected currency. For trades, enter actual principal excluding fees and accrued interest; for income, enter gross amount before tax. Use a decimal point.

investmentJournal.assumedSettlement: Some trades use their trade date as settlement date. Verify this assumption against the broker statement.
investmentJournal.voidHelp: The operation remains in the audit history. If voiding it would invalidate balances or later sales, the entire change is rejected.

Enter confirmed values below; CSV values are not filled automatically. The first posting binds the proposed account to this journal. Posted rows cannot be reassigned between proposed accounts, even after voiding the operation.
investmentJournal.sourceDuplicates: Identical rows exist. Confirm that this is a separate event rather than a duplicate:
investmentJournal.sourceReview: What was verified and which evidence supports it
investmentJournal.sourcePosted: This row is already linked to an operation; it cannot be posted again
investmentJournal.principalHelp: Enter the actual principal repayment. Coupon, tax and fee are separate operations. Full redemption closes the entire position; amortization retains quantity. Nominal must use the operation currency and confirmed issue terms.
investmentJournal.couponUnknown: Some coupons lack confirmed accrued-interest allocations. Earned coupon is unknown for those instruments.

investmentJournal.recoverAll: Entire lot accrued-interest balance at coupon date
investmentJournal.fxHelp: The primary amount is the debit excluding the fee; the fee uses the debit currency. Enter the actual received amount from the statement, not a value derived from analytical FX.
investmentJournal.openingNotice: An opening balance is recorded at the journal start and does not reconstruct earlier history. Describe the evidence in the note. For positions, amount is total clean acquisition cost and accrued interest is its remaining acquired total; no cash is debited.
investmentJournal.openingQuality: This journal contains opening balances; earlier history is not reconstructed. Unknown acquisition cost, interest or acquisition dates limit profit calculations. Unknown amounts are shown as “—”.
investmentJournal.batchHelp: Save the batch to continue reviewing it later. Adding the same source row replaces it. Preview saves the current version on the server; posting requires separate confirmation.
investmentJournal.batchMixedImport: A batch must contain rows from one source export. Check the selected file.
investmentJournal.batchLimit: A batch supports up to 5000 rows and 20 ledgers.
investmentJournal.batchLedgerMissing: The ledger is unavailable. Refresh the journal and check your access.
investmentJournal.batchNoPreview: Get a fresh batch preview first.
investmentJournal.batchUncertain: The posting response was not received. Check the server result or retry the same request. The batch is saved and can be reopened from the list after signing in again.
investmentJournal.batchQuality: History completeness has limitations; portfolio valuation requires market data.

investmentJournal.batchSaveUncertain: The save acknowledgement was not received. Retry saving with the same version and request key.
investmentJournal.batchResultHelp: Saved posting result. These balances are from when the batch was posted; the journal shows the current state.
investmentJournal.distributionHelp: Enter the confirmed quantity ratio and a separate cost allocation fraction. Replacement closes the source position and transfers all cost. Fractional entitlements remain. Describe the evidence in the note.
investmentJournal.distributionMarketHelp: Optional: total fair value of the received securities in {currency} at the event date, with separate valuation evidence. This is not a per-unit amount, FIFO cost share or cash payout. Empty leaves instrument attribution incomplete; 0 means a confirmed zero value.
investmentJournal.expectedSettled: Expected settled cash at reconciliation time
investmentJournal.reconciliationHelp: Enter balances in the selected currency and statement evidence in the note. Reconciliation follows other movements at this timestamp and records the difference. Receivables and payables remain. Changes to prior history require reviewing the reconciliation. An unexplained difference makes period returns incomplete; it is not an automatic contribution or profit.

investmentTransfer.title: Transfer between accounts
investmentTransfer.help: Both sides are saved together. The currency stays the same; fees are separate operations. A transfer does not itself create profit or a contribution to the combined portfolio.
investmentTransfer.securityHelp: FIFO cost, acquired interest and original acquisition dates are preserved. No cash moves. The server checks holdings on the transfer date and later operations in both accounts. Single-account performance requires market value on the transfer date; without it, the calculation is incomplete.

investmentGroups.limits: Groups label strategies; they do not track index constituents. Filters combine selected securities. Cash stays unallocated; group TWR/XIRR is unavailable.

investmentGroups.positions: Instruments by account, including closed positions

investmentComposition.title: Groups and portfolio composition
investmentComposition.policy: The current classification applies to all history. Each point uses prices and FX for its own date; changing groups does not change journal operations.
investmentComposition.filter: Selected groups (none selected means all securities)
investmentComposition.scope: This filter applies to securities value in this section. Other charts, returns and benchmarks on the page describe the full selected portfolio. Group TWR/XIRR is unavailable because group external flows are undefined.
investmentComposition.error: Could not load composition. Reset the filter if a group was removed.

investmentOverview.subtotal: Known subtotal — not the full total

investmentOverview.fxPolicy: Last stored fixings under the selected FX policy. These do not replace historical NAV rates. An expired fixing is not a current quote.

investmentPeriod.title: Period
investmentPeriod.method: Both dates are included. Presets end on the selected date; the profit baseline is the day before the start.

investmentPositions.title: Positions
investmentPositions.policy: Quantities are securities, not broker lots. Market value and weights use portfolio currency; FIFO and clean-price results retain their book currencies. Received payments are not profit: coupons may recover purchased accrued interest. Catalog names are current; terms and prices apply to the selected date. Remaining cost in portfolio currency uses acquisition-date FX rates; partial subtotals are identified separately.
investmentPositions.partial: Market valuation is incomplete or needs recalculation
investmentPositions.acquiredAccrued: Purchased accrued interest not yet recovered
investmentPositions.subtotal: Known subtotal, not a complete total

investmentInstrument.metadataPolicy: Description comes from the current catalog; financial figures use the selected date.
investmentInstrument.holdingsPolicy: FIFO and profit retain the account book currency. Cost in valuation currency uses each remaining lot’s acquisition-date FX rate. Group filters are preserved.
investmentInstrument.unowned: No holdings for the selected date and groups. Market history is available independently of ownership.
investmentInstrument.bondUnknown: Clean and dirty values require reviewed historical terms. Dirty value includes accrued interest only within its explicitly reviewed interval. Provider terms and schedules are available in the listing section below; yield to maturity is not calculated yet.
investmentInstrument.pricePolicy: Daily prices use the reviewed listing and calendar. Each point uses its own date's market FX. Gaps are preserved; dirty prices require confirmed accrued interest.
investmentInstrument.noPrices: No confirmed points for this price mode.
investmentInstrument.markers: Circles: green for buys, red for sells. Markers show the trade date at the daily price, not the execution price. Trades without a daily price are omitted from the chart; all trades remain in the operation history.
investmentInstrument.operationsPolicy: Amount is the actual clean trade principal or gross payment. Accrued interest, fees and taxes are separate. Voided operations remain visible for audit and do not affect balances.
investmentInstrument.noOperations: No operations for the selected accounts and date.
investmentInstrument.changed: The journal or groups changed. Reload the history from the first page.
investmentInstrument.rangeError: Choose a date within the valuation period.
investmentInstrument.noSeries: Create a portfolio valuation to view holdings and converted prices. Source market data is available below.
investmentInstrument.listingPolicy: Selecting a listing opens a market preview. Linking it to the journal requires separate confirmation of dates and price rules. Empty history loads on first access when writes are enabled.
investmentInstrument.rawPolicy: Source candles use provider units and UTC date labels. This separate preview has no FX conversion, nominal normalization or trade markers. Currencies, adjustments and source types are kept separate.

investmentProfit.title: Profit and attribution
investmentProfit.scope: All accounts in the selected portfolio. Composition group filters do not apply to profit: group cash flows are not reconstructed. Currency and FX come from the selected valuation.
investmentProfit.baseline: The baseline is the day before the period; cumulative profit starts at zero. Contributions and withdrawals are excluded. Payments are already in NAV. Gaps are preserved.
investmentProfit.bucketsPolicy: First and last months/years use the selected date boundaries. Each result uses NAV before its own interval and external flows within that interval.
investmentProfit.attributionPolicy: Realized results and earned income use event-date FX; changes in unrealized results use each boundary date’s FX. Cash FX revaluation is separate. The FX / other effects residual includes securities FX, exchanges at actual rates and remaining attribution effects; it is not a proven pure FX return.
investmentProfit.partial: Attribution is incomplete. Unknown cost, accrued interest or FX is not zero; the attribution residual is unavailable.
investmentProfit.informational: Informational: already included in FIFO, not deducted again.

reasons.ledger_history_missing: Missing history at an account boundary
reasons.imported_cash_deficit_reviewed: A cash deficit exception was reviewed for an imported operation.
reasons.negative_imported_cash: Imported cash is negative. This is a history exception, not margin availability.
reasons.imported_cash_history_incomplete: History contains an imported cash deficit. Valuation and returns remain incomplete until it is reconciled.

kinds.earned_income: Earned gross income, excluding recovered accrued interest

investmentContributions.title: Instrument profit contributions
investmentContributions.scope: All series accounts. Search and closed-position filters affect only this table; shares still use the full series result. Composition group filters do not apply here.
investmentContributions.methodText: Contribution = closing market value − market value at the end of the day preceding the period + associated economic cash movements. Purchases, sales, payouts, accrued interest, fees and taxes count once. Values and movements use their own dated FX. Share = contribution / net series profit: this is neither a return nor a position weight; shares may be negative or exceed 100%. Unknown or zero totals have no shares. A noncash distribution adds the reviewed fair value to the source and subtracts it from the received security. This does not change aggregate profit or cash; missing value/FX leaves attribution incomplete.
investmentContributions.partial: Incomplete attribution. Known component subtotals are separate; shares and the remainder are unavailable.
investmentContributions.remainderText: Full series profit less instrument contributions. Includes cash performance, movements without an instrument and reconciliation residuals. It is not assigned to instruments as proven FX income.

kinds.noncash_transfers: Noncash transfers at reviewed fair value

reasons.instrument_contribution_incomplete: Instrument contributions or the full result are unknown.
reasons.noncash_allocation_required: A noncash corporate action requires confirmed market-value allocation; its FIFO cost ratio is not a substitute.
reasons.imported_cash_deficit_reviewed: A cash deficit exception was reviewed for an imported operation.
reasons.negative_imported_cash: Imported cash is negative. This is a history exception, not margin availability.
reasons.imported_cash_history_incomplete: History contains an imported cash deficit. Valuation and returns remain incomplete until it is reconciled.

investmentVariant.title: Valuation currency and FX
investmentVariant.method: Accounts, price rules and the selected period stay the same. Each valuation date and dated cashflow uses its own historical FX. Missing rates remain gaps. New series calculate in the background; completed days appear progressively.
investmentVariant.readOnlyNote: Read-only: already prepared series are available. Creating a new series is disabled.

investmentCurrent.title: Now · provisional valuation
investmentCurrent.method: Whole current accounts, independently of the selected historical period and groups. Stored quotes and FX from selected sources only. Excluded from closed days, CSV, profit and TWR/XIRR; quote timestamps may differ.
investmentCurrent.error: Could not read current valuation. Daily history remains available.
investmentCurrent.complete: All components are known at the stated cutoff; the valuation is provisional.
investmentCurrent.subtotal: Known subtotal. Full current value is not established.

investmentBond.title: Bond terms and payments
investmentBond.policy: Provider evidence at retrieval time. Current nominal and accrued interest do not replace historical valuation terms. The calendar does not establish complete payments or credits to your accounts; yield to maturity is not calculated yet.

investmentBond.empty: The saved provider response has no records for this interval. Calendar completeness is unconfirmed.

investmentLots.title: Remaining FIFO lots
investmentLots.policy: At the selected date, in security units. Acquisition fees are included in cost. Fully disposed lots are not shown. Reporting cost uses the selected FX policy on the acquisition day; see Exact fractions for unrounded values.
investmentLots.changePolicy: Quantity · clean cost · acquired interest, in book currency. Includes all parts of the original acquisition, including transfers between accounts and events in other instruments.

investmentActivation.help: Compare manual value and the journal at the same time. After switching, savings use the journal and retain previous valuations for history. Currency conversion follows savings CBR rules. This switch cannot be undone with a button; reconcile the history first.

investmentPayouts.title: Actual payouts
investmentPayouts.policy: Posted journal cash facts only. Currencies remain separate, without conversion. Coupon cash is not earned income: it may recover acquired accrued interest. Principal and tax refunds are excluded from passive income. This page contains no forecasts.

growth.title: Growth of actual receipts
growth.help: Identical calendar months (Europe/Moscow), using recorded net dividends, coupons, repo income and interest. Monthly amounts run from month start to the cutoff; YoY requires full months and account history for both periods. Purchases and sales affect receipts: this is not dividend growth per share. Currencies stay separate; principal returns, fees and tax refunds are excluded. Import completeness is not independently confirmed.

investmentOperations.title: Investment operations
investmentOperations.policy: All records for the selected accounts, including voided operations. Dates use Moscow time. Unit clean price is derived from clean amount and units (rounded), not a market quote. Cash legs follow journal terms and do not prove broker reconciliation. Voided operations have no cash effect.

investmentPreview.cashDeficitPolicy: Leave blank for strict cash checks. A reason permits only this source-linked operation to increase a cash deficit. Balances and history warnings remain visible; later ordinary debits cannot deepen it. No short positions or margin trading.

investmentTiming.occurredDateOnly: Only the operation date is known
investmentTiming.settlementDateOnly: Only the settlement date is known
investmentTiming.policy: For calculation, trades apply at local day start; cash movements and an explicit settlement date apply at day end. Opening balances and corporate actions precede trades. These are conventions, not actual times. Journal sequence orders operations with the same date; intraday precision is limited.
investmentTiming.transferPolicy: A date without time applies to both sides: securities at civil-day start, cash at civil-day end in the selected timezone. This is a calculation convention, not a known execution time.

investmentLotInput.title: Historical lot conversion
investmentLotInput.policy: The lot size comes from the confirmed period covering the trade date. Current size is not applied to the past. Exact security units and captured terms are saved; later mapping changes do not rewrite posted quantities. If terms are missing, review the mapping or enter known security units.
investmentLotInput.required: Resolve the confirmed lot size for the current date and count.
investmentLotInput.error: Terms are missing, stale or unsuitable for conversion.

investmentTradeFinancials.title: Trade components and settlement
investmentTradeFinancials.enable: Enter price, currencies and actual settlement
investmentTradeFinancials.policy: FIFO currency: {currency}. The quote and cash components preserve their own currencies. Another currency requires a reviewed dated rate to {currency}; no automatic rate is assumed.
investmentTradeFinancials.fxPolicy: Rate {from} → {to} = numerator / denominator. The rate date matches the component date. Preserve its source and evidence.
investmentTradeFinancials.differencePolicy: The actual amount covers the main settlement currency and instant. Other currencies or dates create separate movements. A difference needs a reason; the reviewed difference is allocated to clean principal in FIFO.
investmentTradeFinancials.priceDifference: Clean principal vs quote difference (exact fraction)
investmentTradeFinancials.summary: Book currency summaries are rounded to 12 places for display. Cost uses original amounts and exact FX ratios.
investmentTradeFinancials.quoteFXPolicy: Rate {from} → {to} applies on the execution date. It preserves the original quote while keeping the existing lot currency.
investmentTradeFinancials.includesExpenses: Amount includes commission and tax in the main settlement currency and instant
investmentTradeFinancials.excludesExpenses: The reported amount excludes commission and tax; expenses post separately.
investmentTradeFinancials.signPolicy: Buy: positive debit. Sell: positive credit, or negative debit when expenses exceed proceeds.

investmentForecast.title: Payout forecast
investmentForecast.policy: A scenario for 12 calendar months using registered events, not guaranteed income. An announced amount does not confirm your entitlement. Future cutoffs assume unchanged current holdings; past cutoffs require historical rights and settlement evidence. Tax is optional and estimated; conversion uses currently permitted FX, not future rates. Catalog and import completeness are unconfirmed. A payment date never creates a cash entry.
investmentForecast.counts: Announced rows: {announced}; projected: {projected}; incomplete: {unknown}; reconciled credits: {paid}.
investmentForecast.share: Announced share of registered rows: {percent} (not total portfolio coverage).
investmentForecast.empty: No matching events. This does not mean no future payouts.
investmentForecast.barsHelp: Bars show registered event amounts in the selected currency. Blue: all monthly amounts are known; yellow: known subtotal only. Unknown payouts are not treated as zero.
investmentForecast.catalogHelp: Includes cancelled events and events outside this calendar, including instruments without a current position. Changes retain versions; source and reviewed terms are required.
investmentForecast.cutoffHelp: Explicit RFC3339 with Z or an offset, for example +03:00. No cutoff hour or T+N is inferred from a date or ticker.
investmentForecast.linkHelp: Choose a posted payout for this account, instrument and type. Specify whether it fully settles the event. Forecast tax never replaces actual tax; partial credits do not imply full settlement. Select the current entry again when reviewing a changed link.
investmentForecast.cancelLink: Cancel association, keep the actual cash entry
investmentForecast.confirmComplete: I confirm full reconciliation of this event payout
investmentForecast.error: The request failed. Check the inputs and try again.
investmentForecast.invalid: Invalid event or query. Check dates, amount precision and the 0–100% tax rate.
investmentForecast.denied: Insufficient permissions. Only owners and admins may change events.
investmentForecast.conflict: Data changed. Close this form, refresh the calendar and reopen the entry. Your input was not saved.
investmentForecast.rolesError: Could not verify your role; event editing is unavailable.
investmentForecast.cutoffError: Enter a valid RFC3339 date and time with an explicit offset and at most 6 fractional second digits.

dividendGrowth.title: Dividend growth per share
dividendGrowth.policy: Issuer dividends per share, independent of your holdings, purchases and tax. Years follow the issuer payment date in the reviewed timezone. Ordinary and special dividends are separate; YoY compares ordinary gross dividends for two complete calendar years in the same currency and common share unit. No FX conversion is applied. Unconfirmed payments, missing ordinary amounts, unknown classification or unconfirmed annual coverage suppress the percentage. Registered history is not automatically complete.
dividendGrowth.editorHelp: Amounts are gross per share. Explicitly review every calendar year and ALL share splits between the earliest unit basis and the common basis timestamp. Enter timestamps as RFC3339 with Z or an explicit offset (up to microseconds). Removing a row creates a new revision; previous evidence remains in the audit.
dividendGrowth.empty: No reviewed issuer dividend history. No growth rate can be inferred from personal cash receipts.
dividendGrowth.error: Unable to load or save dividend history.
dividendGrowth.invalid: Invalid history: check dates, source evidence, unique years, positive split ratios and amount precision (12 decimal places). The common basis must not be in the future.
dividendGrowth.instantError: Enter a valid timestamp with Z or an explicit offset, up to six fractional digits.
dividendGrowth.conflict: Data changed. Your input is retained. Close, refresh and reopen the current version before retrying.
dividendGrowth.splitReview: Confirmation of complete intervening split history
dividendGrowth.cancel: Cancel this history, preserve its revisions
dividendGrowth.yearHelp: Mark complete only after reviewing the entire calendar year, including confirmed zero dividends. An absent or incomplete year is unknown; a current year cannot produce completed-year YoY.
dividendGrowth.dividendHelp: Use gross amounts in this history currency. Issuer payment is confirmed by source evidence separately from dates or personal credits. Only confirmed issuer payments enter totals; an announced-only payment keeps the amount unknown. Empty amount is unknown. The unit basis timestamp identifies the source share unit independently of payment date, within the reviewed split range.
dividendGrowth.splitHelp: New units / old units is the share quantity multiplier. Older per-share dividends are multiplied by old / new for each later split through the common basis. A declaration with a unit basis exactly at the split uses the new unit. These rows do not alter your journal.

investmentDividendSource.title: T‑Invest dividend declarations
investmentDividendSource.policy: The period filters record dates. The dividendNet amount and last purchase date are provider evidence: they do not confirm gross income or entitlement. Review the instrument, amount and terms before saving a draft; record actual cash separately. Cancellations and return of capital do not become dividend income.
investmentDividendSource.error: Could not load data. Check the source and period.
investmentDividendSource.empty: The provider returned an empty list for this period.

investmentExport.title: Full investment archive
investmentExport.scope: Archive of this entire organization: journals, import sources, settings, groups and evidence. Market cache and login data are excluded. Restoring all of Budget requires a separate PostgreSQL backup.
investmentExport.privacy: This file contains private financial history. Store it securely. Download is available for 24 hours; up to two active archives are allowed.
investmentExport.ownerOnly: Export is available to organization owners and administrators.
investmentExport.error: Could not prepare or verify the archive. Refresh its status or retry the request.

errors.limit_exceeded: The archive exceeds the size or row limit.
errors.attempts_exhausted: Preparation could not finish after restarts.
errors.export_failed: Could not prepare the complete archive.
